chapters.title: Scope — payment tokens + payment token services

articles.title: Scope — payment tokens + activities
articles.requirement: Captures: (a) Payment Token Issuance — issuing AED-denominated fiat-backed stablecoins + non-AED fiat-backed payment tokens for use in payment within UAE; (b) Payment Token Service Provision — custody, exchange, transmission of payment tokens. Distinct from non-stablecoin virtual assets (which fall under VARA / DFSA / FSRA / SCA scope). CBUAE-supervised; aligned with FDL 10/2025 AML framework.

articles.title: Licensing categories
articles.requirement: Licence categories: (a) Issuer of AED Payment Tokens (Issuer of the AED dirham-pegged stablecoin); (b) Issuer of Other Payment Tokens (non-AED fiat-backed); (c) Payment Token Service Provider (custody, exchange, transmission). Minimum capital prescribed per category proportionate to scale + risk; ongoing capital adequacy reporting.

articles.title: Reserve assets + 100% backing
articles.requirement: Issuers must maintain 100% reserve backing of outstanding payment tokens in high-quality liquid assets (cash deposits, short-term sovereign debt, narrow category of liquid assets per CBUAE notice). Daily reconciliation; independent assurance over reserve balance. Reserves held in segregated accounts with approved custodians + insolvency-remote arrangements.

articles.title: Redemption-at-par right
articles.requirement: Token holders entitled to redeem payment tokens at face value (par) in the underlying fiat currency. Redemption obligation enforceable; redemption process documented; redemption-time standards (T+1 or better for retail; T+0 for institutional where applicable). Restrictions on issuer-imposed redemption fees + delay.

articles.title: AML alignment with FDL 10/2025
articles.requirement: Issuers + service providers subject to AML/CFT/PF obligations under FDL 10/2025 + CR 134/2025 + CBUAE AML notices: entity-wide risk assessment (incl. PF); CDD + EDD; PEPs; SAR via goAML to FIU UAE; sanctions screening; tipping-off prohibition; record retention 5 years.

articles.title: Technology + cybersecurity
articles.requirement: Robust technology-risk management: governance + accountability; secure development; cybersecurity (incl. wallet + key management); IT-incident management + reporting to CBUAE; cloud + IT third-party management; data centre + system availability. Particular emphasis on private-key custody + wallet-security given the bearer-instrument nature of payment tokens.

articles.title: Custody + segregation
articles.requirement: Customer-asset segregation; insolvency-remote arrangements; secure custody (cold + hot wallet structure proportionate to risk; MPC / multi-sig / HSM-based controls); customer-asset reconciliation on prescribed cadence; independent assurance over custody arrangements.

articles.title: Conduct + customer disclosure
articles.requirement: Pre-contract risk disclosures to customers (volatility risk where applicable + insolvency risk + redemption mechanics + reserve composition + dispute-resolution); fair-marketing rules; complaint-handling framework; vulnerable-customer treatment. Marketing restrictions for retail audiences; specific disclosures for cross-border use.

articles.title: Supervision + enforcement
articles.requirement: CBUAE supervisory powers: licence suspension or revocation; CMPs; prohibition orders against individuals; remediation orders. Periodic + ad-hoc reporting (capital + reserves + reconciliation + cybersecurity + AML metrics). Coordination with VARA + DFSA + FSRA + SCA where payment-token issuers also engage in virtual-asset activities across multiple UAE regulators.
